title: Roll out the hierarchical Admin agent team

RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-28 by reading the SQL rather than trusting the manifest: the file is a single `insert into public.agent_identities (...)` with ten value tuples — the nine Admin children plus the Events domain principal — every one with `status = 'pending'`, closing on `on conflict (slug) do nothing`.
